project_goal: Build an evaluable, safe, engineering-grade Dermatology Clinical Intelligence Platform.
current_task: Implement project execution monitoring and recovery foundation
completed_tasks: GitHub repository visibility and permissions verified
next_task: Validate watchdog locally and then continue engineering implementation
architecture_decisions: 10-minute monitoring is a watchdog mechanism, not a forced 10-minute iteration cycle.
RUNNING must be distinguished from actual progress using heartbeat and last_progress timestamps.
WAITING_FOR_HUMAN is not considered a failure or stall.
Automatic recovery must not cross the boundary into high-risk external actions or medical decisions without human approval.
